objective: For every existing proposal, identify its correctness obligations, prerequisite artifacts, unresolved assumptions and minimum independent review needed before a future toy benchmark. Produce an auditable priority recommendation only.
boundary: No solver code, parameter-optimization recipe, attack blueprint, key recovery, benchmark execution, new asymptotic result or closure claim.
No arbitrary rejection because a lane is studied. Distinguish an untested claim from a verified obstruction.
The proposed future benchmark is design-only with approved_by:null and executable:false.
Read local frozen primary-source passages when used; record provenance internal or retrieved according to actual access, and distinguish author-reported measurements from reproduction.
Nearest-work/Pareto comparison remains unchecked unless actual comparison is performed; never set dominated_by:null as a claim of non-domination without a check.
required_obligations: The five proposal IDs and separate prerequisite status with evidence paths.
Encoding soundness and completeness, SAT witness verification, UNSAT certificate handling, matched nulls, separate SAT/UNSAT reporting and total cost accounting.

Four proof-search-map audits: exact baseline reproduction, observation-collision search, quantifier order, and method ceiling/nearby-object control; record pending/not-applicable with reasons, never invent a passed audit.
One ranked next design action with rationale and remaining uncertainty; no execution approval.

format.intake.md: Concise source-backed prerequisite inventory and rationale.
format.benchmark-obligations.json: Design-only high-level obligations, approved_by:null, executable:false, proposal mapping and audit states.
format.sources.json: Exact local source paths read, SHA-256 hashes and scope of each citation; no fabricated source retrieval or model identity.
